description: This file contains JavaScript code for rendering and interacting with streaming page visualizations in Apache Spark UI, including timeline and histogram graphs, tooltips, and batch row highlighting.

methods.name: showBootstrapTooltip
methods.description: Displays a tooltip with specified text for a given D3 selection node.

methods.name: hideBootstrapTooltip
methods.description: Disposes of the tooltip for a given D3 selection node.

methods.name: getMaxMarginLeftForTimeline
methods.description: Returns the maximum left margin used for timeline graphs to align them.

methods.name: getOnClickTimelineFunction
methods.description: Returns a function that scrolls to and highlights a batch row when a timeline point is clicked.

methods.name: registerTimeline
methods.description: Registers a timeline graph to determine the maximum left margin based on Y-axis max value.

methods.name: registerHistogram
methods.description: Registers a histogram graph to determine the maximum X value for all histograms.

methods.name: drawTimeline
methods.description: Draws a timeline graph with interactive points, tooltips, and optional batch interval line.

methods.name: drawHistogram
methods.description: Draws a histogram graph with interactive bars, tooltips, and optional batch interval line.
